item.title: K21 Health Foundation Awards Over $1.2 Million in Grants to Area Nonprofits
item.description: K21 Health Foundation announces grants totaling $1,280,163 to nonprofit organizations whose projects improve the health and wellness of Kosciusko County residents.

item.title: Gov. Mike Braun Announces Kentucky Manufacturer, Recycler Relocating Headquarters to Indiana
item.description: Gov. Mike Braun announced today that Global Polymers, a Kentucky-based small business and provider of recycled plastic products, plans to expand its operations in Charlestown, creating up to 30 new jobs by the end of 2030.

item.title: Plymouth Man Found Guilty Of Sex Crimes Against Child
item.description: The Marshall County Prosecutor’s Office announced on Tuesday, Feb. 3, the conviction of Aaron Ganshorn, 46, Plymouth, for sex crimes against a child.

item.title: Van Buren Township Board Approves Annual Report, Fire Contract
item.description: The Van Buren Township Advisory Board met Tuesday, Feb. 3 to go over 2025's annual report and approve its fire protection agreement with Milford Volunteer Fire Department.

item.title: Turkey Creek Fire Captain Placed On Unpaid Leave
item.description: In a brief special meeting held Tuesday, Feb. 3, the Turkey Creek Township Advisory Board to "move an employee from paid leave to unpaid leave pending the outcome of a legal matter." Unpaid leave will start Wednesday, Feb. 4.

item.title: North Webster EMS Celebrates 50th Anniversary
item.description: Jan. 1 marks the 50th anniversary of North Webster Emergency Medical Services and the 30th anniversary of the first paramedic service based in northern Kosciusko County in Tippecanoe Township.

item.title: Wawasee Kiwanis Hosts Annual Soup Supper
item.description: It was perfect soup weather as the Wawasee Kiwanis Club hosted its annual Soup Supper at the Syracuse Community Center Saturday, Jan. 30.
